title: Approval gate for auto-rerun is workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' only, since the approval artifact is gone
answers: auto rerun triggers on comments or change requests instead of approvals
why does the rerun workflow run when a review is not an approval
how does rerun-workflow-run know the PR was approved
approval-triggered rerun skipped for non-approving reviews
body:
Invariant: rerun-workflow-run.yml must only rerun when the upstream rerun.yml run concluded `success`. The approval check lives in rerun.yml's job-level `if` (review.state == 'approved' and the allowlisted author).
Symptom it guards: a comment, change request, or unauthorized review must not restart PR checks.
Why it holds: a job skipped by its `if` does not fail the run. A run whose only job is skipped concludes `skipped`, not `success`, so the `workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'` condition fails and the rerun job does not run.
What breaks if skipped: the removed PR-number artifact used to be the approval marker (its download failed for non-approving runs). Without an equivalent gate, any completed rerun.yml run would trigger reruns.
Constraints: this relies on rerun.yml having a single job. If another job is added to rerun.yml that can succeed on a non-approving review, the success gate no longer proves approval.
applies: The approval-triggered rerun path across .github/workflows/rerun.yml and .github/workflows/rerun-workflow-run.yml only.
says: Automated test rerun triggers on review comments or change requests instead of approvals
Pull request checks restart unexpectedly when an unauthorized user submits review feedback
Only restart automated pull request tests when an authorized team member approves changes
Non-approving review activity triggers unnecessary continuous integration test reruns
Ensure automated workflow reruns only execute after an explicit pull request approval
search: In .github/workflows/rerun-workflow-run.yml, rerun execution must gate strictly on workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' from .github/workflows/rerun.yml. The approval check is evaluated in rerun.yml's job-level if condition (review.state == 'approved' and allowlisted author), which causes non-approving reviews to conclude as skipped. This invariant replaces the removed PR-number artifact gate and relies on rerun.yml containing only a single job.
